Name: Outcrops
Description: Controls the number of unique outcrop shapes generated before repetition. Higher values create more visual diversity among outcrops.

Name: Variations
Description: Controls the number of unique outcrop shapes generated before repetition. Higher values create more visual diversity among outcrops.

Name: Strata
Description: Adds visible geological layering or banding to the outcrops, simulating sedimentary or stratified rock formations. High values increase the distance between Strata layers.

Name: Density
Description: Adjusts how many outcrops are placed across the terrain. Higher values increase the number of outcrops per area.

Name: Shape
Description: Determines the overall form and silhouette of each outcrop, affecting their appearance and how they blend with the terrain.

Name: Chipped
Description: Controls the amount of chipping or breakage on the outcrops, simulating natural weathering and erosion effects.

Name: Seed
Description: Sets the randomization seed for outcrop generation, ensuring reproducible or varied results with each value.

Name: Variation Range
Description: Specifies the base size of each outcrop, affecting their footprint and prominence on the terrain.

Name: Size
Description: Specifies the base size of each outcrop, affecting their footprint and prominence on the terrain.

Name: Height
Description: Controls the vertical scale of the outcrops, determining how tall or flat they appear.

Name: Rotation
Description: Applies random or specified rotation to each outcrop, increasing natural variation and preventing repetitive patterns.
